items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: did Lytel ever play with the band? Lytel yes he did yes he played uh uh when we first went to the to uh the Balconades that was 19 19 1922

ctx.x: I have heard them and it seems to me he plays very close to your parts on them yes you must have listened very carefully to your records were there any other changes after Robinson came in? Signorelli came with us

yes that's right you mentioned that and then uh after we left the Foley-Bergé we uh did some uh one night stands in Pennsylvania and Frankie Signorelli played those Henry only came to New York and worked at the Balconades Shields didn't wish to come to New York and he left the band returned to New Orleans and went to California I think where his wife was living and we got Artie Seberg Artie Seberg played his tone was almost like Shields it was difficult to tell them apart and he played all Shields uh style and…
I like that Albert system myself you do yes I think it has a better tone somehow
